title: The Dame With the Hat
description: A seven-scene branching detective noir audio drama featuring Jack Marlowe, Vivian Cross, Betty and Knuckles Malone.

scenes.title: The Dame With the Hat
scenes.imageAlt: A 1940s detective sits in a dark office overlooking a rainy city.
scenes.text: Vivian Cross asks detective Jack Marlowe to investigate her missing husband Ernest. Two leads emerge: Ernest's apartment and the Crooked Canary nightclub.

choices.text: Question Knuckles Malone at the Crooked Canary.

scenes.title: A Hat Full of Trouble
scenes.imageAlt: A shadowed detective questions a poised woman beneath stark office lighting.
scenes.text: Marlowe visits Ernest's apartment and learns more about the missing hat, the metal clasp, and Victor Sterling.

choices.text: Contact Betty and follow the new clues.

scenes.title: Knuckles and Sandwiches
scenes.imageAlt: A lone detective approaches a rain-soaked city street at night.
scenes.text: At the Crooked Canary, Marlowe questions Knuckles Malone and uncovers a connection to Victor Sterling and locker 47.

choices.text: Call Betty and investigate the locker clue.

scenes.title: Betty Does the Detecting
scenes.imageAlt: A detective studies files and photographs at a cluttered desk by a rainy window.
scenes.text: Betty examines the hat and discovers further evidence. The trail now splits toward Sterling or the hat's hidden secrets.

scenes.title: A Millionaire's Bluff
scenes.imageAlt: Gloved hands examine a sealed envelope and photographs under a detective's lamp.
scenes.text: The investigation turns toward Victor Sterling and his secrets.

choices.text: Bring the clues together and close the case.

scenes.title: The Great Hat Caper
scenes.imageAlt: A detective examines a pocket watch in a shadowy shop filled with clocks.
scenes.text: The mystery of the stolen hat and its concealed evidence comes to a head.

choices.text: Bring the clues together and close the case.

scenes.title: Case Closed
scenes.imageAlt: A fedora-wearing detective surveys a rain-drenched alley beneath a streetlamp.
scenes.text: Jack Marlowe reaches the conclusion of his investigation.
